changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate tasks, removed redundant dataset names, and simplified output descriptions. Kept only the main generative retrieval task since identifier generation is part of the overall generative retrieval approach.
Normalized metric names to standard forms and removed abbreviated versions (R@ → Recall@, M@ → MRR@). All variants refer to the same base metrics.
Confirmed that the paper does not use LLMs as judges for evaluation. The paper uses LLMs (BART, T5) for generation but not for post-hoc evaluation of outputs.
Confirmed that the paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are based on automatic metrics using ground truth relevance labels.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on generative retrieval using multiple identifier types (titles, substrings, pseudo-queries) and evaluates performance using standard information retrieval metrics. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches are used. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of redundant items and normalization of metric names.
